description:
Cast Through the Breach by paying {4}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Through the Breach.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Through the Breach, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
